pullRequest.title: docs: note immutable releases starting v2.93.0
pullRequest.body:
We have enabled immutable releases on `gh` for our future releases.

This adds a short note to the "Verification of binaries" section of the README letting users know that releases of `gh` will be immutable starting with v2.93.0.
